He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]] and was drafted by the Pelicans with the 21st pick of the [[2024 NBA draft]]. ==Early life and high school career== Missi was born on 14 May 2004{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbadraft.net/players/yves-missi/|website=NBADraft.net|title=Yves Missi}} in [[Belgium]] but grew up in [[Yaoundé]], Cameroon.{{Cite magazine |date=11 September 2023 |title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: Baylor's Yves Missi |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-baylors-yves-missi |access-date=31 December 2024 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]}}{{Cite web |last=Moseley |first=Davis |date=14 July 2022 |title=Well-traveled five-star Yves Missi is here |url=https://www.on3.com/sites/maize-blue-review/news/well-traveled-five-star-yves-missi-is-here/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=31 December 2024 |website=[[On3.com]]}} He moved to the United States in 2021 and began attending [[West Nottingham Academy]] in Maryland.{{Cite magazine |last=McCallister |first=Mike |date=5 May 2022 |title=Yves Missi Has Developed Into a High Major Prospect |url=https://www.si.com/college/syracuse/recruiting/yves-missi-developed-high-major-recruit |access-date=31 December 2024 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]}} He later transferred to [[Prolific Prep]] in [[Napa, California]], and averaged 9.3 points, 8.7 rebounds and 1.3 blocks per game.{{Cite news |last=Nicholas |first=Foster |date=6 November 2023 |title=Bears add depth: Get to know fresh faces of Baylor men's basketball |url=https://baylorlariat.com/2023/11/06/bears-add-depth-get-to-know-fresh-faces-of-baylor-mens-basketball/ |access-date=31 December 2024 |newspaper=[[The Baylor Lariat]]}} A five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he was highly recruited and was ranked by [[ESPN]] as the second-best player in California, the 13th-best player nationally and third-best [[Center (basketball)|center]].{{Cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |last2=Biancardi |first2=Paul |author-link2=Paul Biancardi |name-list-style=and |date=4 January 2023 |title=Top 25 junior Missi chooses Baylor, 'the right place for me' |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/35380294 |access-date=31 December 2024 |publisher=[[ESPN]]}}{{Cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=3 May 2023 |title=Yves Missi reclassifies to 2023 class for Baylor basketball |url=https://www.espn.com/recruiting/basketball/story/_/id/37327961 |access-date=31 December 2024 |publisher=[[ESPN]]}} Missi played at the [[Nike Hoop Summit]] in 2023 and won The Grind Session World Championship with Prolific Prep, earning a place at the GEICO High School Nationals.{{Cite web |title=Yves Missi |url=https://baylorbears.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/yves-missi/12472 |access-date=31 December 2024 |publisher=[[Baylor Bears]]}} He also played in the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] (EYBL) and averaged 12.7 points, 9.9 rebounds and 2.8 blocks per game with the PSA Cardinals.{{Cite news |date=4 January 2023 |title=Missi commits to Baylor men's basketball |url=https://wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/missi-commits-to-baylor-mens-basketball/article_f7d889dc-8c89-11ed-b47f-c3714b0229c0.html |access-date=31 December 2024 |newspaper=[[Waco Tribune-Herald]]}} He committed to playing college basketball for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]] and reclassified to be able to join them for the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]].{{Cite web |last=Salerno |first=Cameron |date=3 May 2023 |title=College basketball recruiting: Baylor commit Yves Missi reclassifies, will join Bears for 2023-24 season |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/college-basketball-recruiting-baylor-commit-yves-missi-reclassifies-will-join-bears-for-2023-24-season/ |access-date=31 December 2024 |work=[[CBS Sports]]}} ==College career== Missi impressed early in the [[2023–24 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|2023–24 Baylor season]].{{Cite magazine |last=Condra |first=Isaac |date=20 December 2023 |title=2024 NBA Draft: Breaking Down Baylor's Yves Missi |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/2024-nba-draft-breaking-down-baylors-yves-missi |access-date=31 December 2024 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]}} Following his freshman season, he declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]] and received a green room invite.{{Cite web |last=Kirschenbaum |first=Alex |date=2024-06-14 |title=Several More Players Invited To Green Room For 2024 Draft |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/06/six-more-players-invited-to-green-room-for-2024-draft.html |access-date=2024-12-31 |website=Hoops Rumors |language=en-US}} Missi earned Big 12 All-Defensive and All-Freshman honors in 2024, finishing his one-and-done campaign with averages of 10.7 points, 5.6 rebounds and 1.5 blocks in just 23.0 minutes per game while shooting 61.4% from the field and generating 4.1 free-throw attempts per game. ==Professional career== On 26 June 2024, Missi was selected with the 21st overall pick by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]]{{cite web |last=Dodson |first=Chris |date=26 June 2024 |title=Pelicans 2024 NBA Draft grade for Yves Missi |url=https://clutchpoints.com/pelicans-2024-nba-draft-grade-yves-missi |access-date=27 June 2024 |website=ClutchPoints}} and on July 8, he signed with the Pelicans.{{cite web |date=8 July 2024 |title=New Orleans Pelicans sign Yves Missi |url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/yves-missi-center-rookie-contract-new-orleans-pelicans-roster-signing |access-date=8 July 2024 |website=NBA.com}} On 23 October, Missi made his NBA debut, putting up 12 points, seven rebounds, three blocks, one assist and one steal in a 123–111 win over the [[Chicago Bulls]].{{cite web |last=Dammarell |first=Evan |date=24 October 2024 |title=Pelicans' Yves Missi's debut gets eye-opening Willie Green praise |url=https://clutchpoints.com/pelicans-news-yves-missi-debut-willie-green-praise |access-date=25 October 2024 |website=ClutchPoints}} On 16 March 2026, Missi became the fifth player in New Orleans franchise history to record 10 rebounds, 5 blocks, and 5 assists. == National team career == On 30 June 2025, Missi announced that he would make his [[Cameroon men's national basketball team|Cameroon national team]] debut at [[FIBA AfroBasket 2025|AfroBasket 2025]].{{Cite web |date=2025-06-29 |title=NBA rising star Missi set to debut for Cameroon at AfroBasket |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-afrobasket-2025/news/missi-set-to-debut-for-cameroon-at-afrobasket |access-date=2025-07-01 |website=www.fiba.basketball |language=en}} He debuted on August 13, 2025, and scored 12 points in a group stage win over [[Tunisia men's national basketball team|Tunisia]].{{Cite web |date=2025-08-13 |title=Cameroon ends Tunisia's decade-long unbeaten run |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-afrobasket-2025/news/cameroon-ends-tunisias-decade-long-unbeaten-run |access-date=2025-08-14
